paper.title_en: How much of the black hole ringdown is sourced within the light ring?
paper.abstract_en: Not much. It has been proposed that applying a rational filter to a black hole ringdown gravitational waveform reveals a direct wave component sourced near the event horizon. By solving the Teukolsky equation for a point particle plunging into a Kerr black hole, I show that the maximum amplitude of the waves sourced within the prograde light ring is $\lesssim 10\%$ that of those sourced by the full trajectory no matter if the waves are filtered or not. This agrees with the interpretation of quasinormal modes as waves orbiting the light ring and the direct wave as the power of these modes redistributed in time. Therefore, both quasinormal modes and direct waves are more a probe of the light ring than the near-horizon region. For GW250114, I estimate that the component of the waves sourced within the light ring have a signal-to-noise ratio $ρ\lesssim 1$ measured after the peak of the filtered waves.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨了黑洞铃宕中光环与视界对波形贡献的相对大小，涉及相对论与黑洞物理的核心问题，具有理论深度与新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞铃宕中有多少源于光环内部？
decision.abstract_zh: 不多。已有研究提出，对黑洞铃宕引力波形应用有理滤波器可以揭示出视界附近产生的直接波分量。通过求解点粒子陷入Kerr黑洞时的Teukolsky方程，我展示了无论是否滤波，来自顺行光环内部的波的最大振幅约为全轨迹产生波振幅的10%以下。这与准正则模式被解释为绕光环传播的波，以及直接波是这些模式在时间上重新分布的能量相一致。因此，准正则模式和直接波更多地是光环而非视界附近区域的探针。对于GW250114，我估计来自光环内部的波分量在滤波波峰值之后测得的信噪比ρ≤1。
